criteria.name: outside-mask preservation
criteria.finding: Deterministic compose reports zero changed channels outside the hard mask.

criteria.name: boundary and residue
criteria.finding: Boundary scan passes; 100% and 200% views show no visible patch rectangle or residual wall silhouette.

criteria.name: structure continuity
criteria.finding: Wall courses, corner, toilet tank and floor remain visually continuous around the inserted vent.

criteria.name: runtime readability
criteria.finding: The vent reads clearly at the whole-scene scale without becoming implausibly large.
